### Integration Updates


- [Omnitracs XRS](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/omnitracs-xrs) now supports[Trips](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/trip) ,` engine_runtime` in[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log) , and[Trailers](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/trailer)
- [GPS Trackit](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/gps-trackit) now maps provider driver IDs onto[Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-location) when available


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now shows a dedicated "Connection not found" page for invalid or deleted connection IDs


### Consent Flow Updates


- Link templates now support regex validation for required` external_id` values, with validation enforced in both Link and` /link/complete`


### Feature Updates


- Added a read-only Viewer role with tighter role-based access controls across dashboard and API surfaces


### API Updates


- Added a public usage endpoint:[GET /usage](https://docs.withterminal.com/api-reference/usage/list-usage)
- Added` connection.pending_deletion` and` connection.deleted` webhook lifecycle events, plus deleted-connection responses that preserve useful audit context


### Documentation Updates


- Documented the hosted Link` template` query parameter and default-template behavior
- Updated provider metadata and docs for GPS Insight sample rate ranges and Transit ELD login URL guidance
